text: Idk if it is yet working in terms of the paint lines. the orange does not show tho. hm. [Image #5] [Image #6]
resolution: Parking stall lines now survive the compiled floor bake. The painter drew the white bay lines but the loaded game showed none: the floor texture bakes at 4 px/tile, so texel centres sit 0.25 tiles apart and the nearest one to a 3-tile bay line is up to 0.125 tiles away, while the line only painted within 0.10 tiles — it fell between texels and was never sampled (classic sub-texel aliasing). Fix widens the full-white core to 0.16 tiles (clearing the 0.125 worst case) at all three lockstep sites: the game heightfield shader, its CPU bake mirror (heightfieldTexelColor), and the editor painter view, so painter==game stays exact. The prior test false-passed by sampling exactly on the line; it now walks the real 4 px/tile texel grid the bake uses. Resolution-bump was rejected (would blow texture memory on a full city). The orange-marker half of the original report (markers no longer paint the game ground) was already confirmed working by the user. groundResolve 5/5, cart bundles clean. Committed 7c4722d90.
